findings.code_snippet:
self-imposed "shoulds" — accepting that disabled is real, not a failure of
effort — frees capacity that perfectionism and internalized ableism were
consuming. Recovery plans that add more outings, socializing, or
conventional self-care rituals without checking fit can worsen deficit
when those activities are net-depleting for the person (see [social energy
as spendable capacity](social-energy-as-spendable-capacity.md)).
findings.message: Skill enables autonomous high-impact decisions without human-in-the-loop verification. Critical operations (destructive commands, financial transactions, data deletion) should require explicit user confirmation.
findings.remediation: Add human-in-the-loop confirmation for destructive, irreversible, or high-impact operations. Never auto-execute commands that modify files, send data, or alter system state.

findings.code_snippet:
The distinguishing test is outcome, not category or social legibility: does
this activity actually leave more headroom afterward, or does it just feel
like rest in the moment while net capacity keeps falling? This matters for
pacing because a schedule that allocates "rest time" without checking
whether that time is spent on restorative or cheap rest will show a
capacity deficit persisting despite apparently-adequate downtime on paper.
It also means the same activity can be restorative for one person, one

findings.code_snippet:
The personal-capacity parallel is familiar: a late-week social event, travel
day, or deadline crunch may be affordable in isolation but unaffordable
after three nights of short sleep and back-to-back masking. A calendar that
green-lights each entry without asking "what is already depleted going
into this?" will reliably overbook the end of a cycle and under-schedule
recovery. See [acute and chronic fatigue](acute-and-chronic-fatigue.md)
for how repeated small shortfalls compound, and [proactive recovery

findings.message: Skill attempts to fill the context window with filler content, displacing legitimate instructions and safety constraints. This can degrade agent performance or bypass safety boundaries.
findings.remediation: Implement context-window management that detects and rejects padding or stuffing attempts. Prioritize system instructions over user-injected content.
